{{Quote|A special Imperial Operative has infiltrated the Rebel Alliance and is stowed away aboard a Corellian Corvette called 'The Gaaltura V.' Reports indicate that this vessel is headed through the Kashyyyk system very soon. [...] We wish to activate this special Operative. Once she receives her orders, she will fight her way to the bridge and take command of the vessel. Before she can do her job, you must intercept and disable the Corvette.|An Imperial officer, to an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:HSHaIOstnoaAC" />}}
The '''''Gaaltura V''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was captured in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
